settings.breed_blurb: India's original desi dog — resilient, loving and full of character. Indie dogs deserve the same style and love as any pedigree.
settings.tip_lehenga: Indian street dogs vary widely in size — measure carefully. Most Indie dogs fit S to L. Choose breathable cotton for comfort.
settings.tip_sherwani: A classic sherwani in a warm earthy tone celebrates the Indie dog's desi heritage beautifully. Perfect for Diwali and festive shoots.
settings.tip_tshirt: Lightweight cotton tees are ideal for Indie dogs who are used to Indian weather. S/M sizes work for most Indie body types.
settings.tip_colours: Earthy tones like terracotta, turmeric yellow and forest green look stunning and celebrate the Indie dog's natural Indian aesthetic.
